prelims.name: Preliminary Examination
prelims.purpose: Screening test only. Marks do NOT count toward final rank.

CSAT_Paper2.name: Civil Services Aptitude Test (CSAT)
CSAT_Paper2.qualifying_marks: 33% (66 marks) — qualifying only, not counted for merit

mains.name: Main Examination
mains.purpose: Primary merit stage. Marks count toward final rank.

Essay.description: Candidates must write essays on multiple topics. Expected to keep close to the subject, to arrange ideas in orderly fashion, and to write concisely. Credit given for effective and exact expression.
common_themes: Ethics and values in public life

Strengthening of ethical and moral values in governance

Information sharing and transparency in government
Ethical dilemmas faced by civil servants
Welfare of marginalised vs procedural compliance

Paper_A.name: Indian Language (Compulsory)
Paper_A.description: Any one of the 22 languages in the 8th Schedule. Tests reading, comprehension, essay writing, and translation.

Paper_B.name: English (Compulsory)
Paper_B.description: Tests English comprehension, précis writing, essay, and translation from Indian language to English.

interview.name: Personality Test / Interview
interview.description: Tests mental calibre, intellectual depth, social traits, integrity. Based on detailed application form (DAF). No specific syllabus — current affairs, your work/academic background, situational questions.

final_merit.note: Prelims marks are NOT included in final merit calculation.

news_relevance_scoring.description: How to score a news article's UPSC relevance. Used to filter out non-relevant news.
criteria: Does it involve Indian government policy or legislation?
Does it involve India's foreign relations?
Does it have economic implications for India?
Does it involve environment, climate, or disaster?
Does it involve science/tech with Indian context?
Does it involve social justice, welfare, or marginalized groups?
Does it involve constitutional or legal developments?
Does it involve internal security or border issues?
Is there a previous year UPSC question on a related topic?
news_relevance_scoring.threshold: If article scores YES on 2 or more criteria, it is UPSC-relevant.
